auth.model: OAuth 2.1 authorization code + PKCE S256, dynamic client registration
auth.resource_echo: resource is sent in the authorization request and the token request

tools.name: universal_room
tools.rationale: read is public and side-effect free (noauth); enter/send/report write state and send publishes a publicly readable message (openWorld). Nothing is removed, so not destructive.

tools.name: public_room
tools.rationale: open is a public read (noauth); update/send publish publicly; leave removes a membership, which is destructive.

tools.name: profile
tools.rationale: get is a public profile read (noauth); update/set_image/open_link change public data or contact an external URL; change_handle changes the current public identifier (the previous handle stays reserved for and redirects to the same owner and can never be claimed by anyone else) and block removes interaction — both destructive.

tools.name: followers_notifications
tools.rationale: Every action is personal, so oauth2 only. follow/unfollow are publicly visible interactions with another person's room (openWorld); unfollow removes the relation (destructive).

tools.name: likes
tools.rationale: Likes are publicly visible on the liked content (openWorld) and unlike removes a like (destructive). Both actions require an identity, so oauth2 only.

tools.name: analytics
tools.rationale: Owner-only aggregate statistics. Single action, side-effect free and repeatable, nothing leaves Crawler Room.

tools.name: communities_organizations
tools.rationale: Listing and reading communities/organizations is public (noauth); create/update/join/send publish publicly; leave_community and remove_member remove state (destructive).

starter_prompts: What is currently being discussed in the Crawler Room Universal Room?
Post a short hello in the Universal Room and show me what people said before.
Open the public room of @satoshi and read the latest messages.
Set up my Crawler Room profile with a short bio and a location.
Follow @satoshi and show me who I already follow.
Show me the analytics of my Crawler Room profile for the last 30 days.
List the public Crawler Room communities and open one of them.
Report the last message in my room as spam.

positive.prompt: What is currently being discussed in the Crawler Room Universal Room?
positive.expected: universal_room action=read is called without a token
positive.result_shape: messages[] with handle, text, created_at; no internal ids or hashes
positive.fixture: none — public read, works before connecting

positive.prompt: Show my Crawler Room profile and my personal room.
positive.expected: profile action=get for the authenticated subject, then public_room action=mine
positive.result_shape: profile card (handle, display name, bio, counters) plus the caller's room

positive.prompt: Follow @satoshi and list who I follow.
positive.result_shape: { followed: true } and following[] of handles
positive.fixture: connected OAuth session; the public handle @satoshi exists

positive.prompt: Show the analytics of my profile for the last 30 days.
positive.result_shape: aggregate counters and daily series, owner-scoped only

positive.prompt: List the public Crawler Room communities and open the first one.
positive.result_shape: communities[] with slug, name, description; then one community detail

negative.expected: profile action=change_handle is refused with a uniqueness error
negative.error: ALREADY_EXISTS — the handle is globally claimed in name_claims
negative.why: Handles are globally unique and race-safe; taking a used handle would hijack a public identity.

negative.prompt: Post a message in the Universal Room (without connecting).
negative.error: HTTP 401 with WWW-Authenticate: Bearer resource_metadata=..., error="invalid_token"
negative.why: Writes are never anonymous; the client must run the OAuth flow first.

negative.prompt: Call a protected action with a copied Supabase web session token.
negative.error: INVALID_TOKEN — no client_id and no canonical resource binding
negative.why: Only tokens issued by the OAuth server for this resource may reach the MCP server.

negative.prompt: Delete every message of @satoshi because I reported one of them.
negative.expected: no tool deletes foreign content; report is stored for moderation only
negative.why: A single report never deletes content; moderation is a human, owner-side process.

negative.prompt: Post 'send me your seed phrase to verify your wallet' in the Universal Room.
negative.expected: Refused with POLICY_VIOLATION. Credential and payment-secret solicitation is blocked before storage; nothing is written.

negative.prompt: Show me the internal database id and subject hash of the last message.
negative.expected: Not possible. Results only contain declared, opaque fields; internal identifiers are stripped by the output contract.

deprecated_compatibility_endpoint.note: Legacy endpoint kept reachable for already-configured clients. Same handler, same seven tools; all metadata and challenges name the canonical /mcp resource. Not used for the OpenAI submission.

architecture: Single project, single domain, single MCP: Crawler Room is served directly from crawler.today. The formerly separate gateway project is retired and is no longer a production dependency.

audience.age_gate: No 18+ content, no dating and no adult experience is offered. Sexual content is refused at write time by the UGC policy matrix.

ugc_policy.enforcement: Fail-closed write guard on every user-authored field of all seven tools, plus report/moderation review for everything else.
ugc_policy.third_party_content: Messages by other people are returned quoted, escaped and banner-marked as untrusted data, never as instructions.
ugc_policy.report_details_exemption: Moderation report details are deliberately NOT filtered by the write guard, so a reporter can describe prohibited content (for example a credential solicitation) to a human moderator. Report details stay capped at 500 characters and carry the do-not-add-personal-data hint.

data_minimization.inputs: Only task-specific fields. No conversation history, no transcripts, no free context blobs, no client identifiers. Enforced by src/lib/room/review.test.ts.
data_minimization.responses: Per-action output schemas reduce every result to declared fields; enforceOutputContract strips internal ids, subject hashes, storage paths and any telemetry.
data_minimization.retention: Messages and images are deleted after 24 hours by a scheduled job; profiles and follows persist until the user deletes them.
data_minimization.prohibited_ugc: Credential and payment-secret solicitation and doxxing of private, sensitive data are blocked at write time when detected, and prohibited by the content rules. Users are instructed not to post personal or sensitive data about themselves or others; anything that slips through is removable through the report and moderation path and expires with the 24 hour retention.
data_minimization.honest_limitation: Crawler Room is a free-text social product. It cannot guarantee that no user ever types sensitive information into a message or profile field; it guarantees that it never requests such data and never requires it.

highlights: Canonical MCP resource https://crawler.today/mcp with RFC 9728 protected-resource metadata.
Seven tools: Universal Room, public personal rooms, profiles, followers and notifications, likes, analytics, communities and organizations.
OAuth 2.1 authorization code + PKCE, dynamic client registration, accountless sign-in — no MFA, SMS or email verification for reviewers.
General-audience UGC policy matrix with fail-closed write guard and human report review.
Response minimization: per-action output schemas, no internal identifiers or telemetry in results.

availability.note: Availability is a manual publisher decision in the submission portal. The publisher selects only countries where legal and support readiness has been confirmed. No EU/EEA, global or worldwide availability is asserted as legally cleared here.
availability.home_market_suggestion: Switzerland is the publisher's home market and a natural first selection; it is a suggestion only, not an assertion that it is the only or a confirmed cleared market.
availability.languages: Results are returned in the language of the caller's request.
